title: Ethiopian Empire (c. 1137-1974)
key_facts: One of oldest Christian kingdoms in Africa
Successfully resisted European colonization except Italian occupation
Defeated Italians at Battle of Adwa (1896)
Only African nation to defeat European colonial power in battle
causes: Zagwe dynasty's establishment of Christian kingdom
Control of highlands and trade routes
Military organization and unique terrain advantage
outcome: Italian occupation during WWII ended imperial rule
Legacy of African resistance and pride
impacts: Demonstrated African capability to resist colonialism
Established Ethiopia as symbol of African sovereignty
